source_notes: US undergraduate health-administration / health-services-administration / health-management programs plus healthcare-management student organizations and honor societies. Every email was read on the listed official (or org) page and verified by direct extraction; no email was guessed or pattern-completed. Generic inboxes are labelled 'generic'. Named-category emails are the staffer's personal campus login shown in a 'mailto:' or Contact block. Error on the side of fewer-but-certain.
